The structure of Mg2In2Mo2O8 (MgInMoO4) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows In and Mo each adopt octahedral environments with six O neighbors, while Mg centers are coordinated by four O neighbors. The In and Mo octahedra share corners, and In–Mg and Mo–Mg polyhedra display both corner- and edge-sharing relations. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
